notes: Grown on a placed farm tile; a tile without a farm object is rejected (src/journey.js gardenAction).
The quickest sowing in the garden at fifteen minutes, and the largest single harvest at three, so a resident who wants resources sooner trades a tighter tending window for them.

A single tend shortens growth by five minutes, capped by the growth still ahead of the crop. Because the care bands divide the crop's own growth, a bountiful blossom needs its tend inside the first five minutes.
Seeds themselves are free and unlimited; the twenty-crop garden cap is unchanged.
